description: Returns the checkout page link for one package and billing period, so the person can finish and pay themselves. Nothing is bought yet: no order exists and nothing is charged until the person signs in, accepts the purchase terms and pays on Stripe. You cannot pay, accept terms or set a price, and you never see card details. The price in the reply is for information; the checkout page shows the final price. Packages are for virtual assistants: other accounts are blocked at checkout. Read-only and safe to repeat; it changes nothing.

billingPeriod.description: one_time, 3_months, 6_months or 12_months. Must be one of the offers of the package.

countryCode.description: Two-letter ISO country code for the price list, for example NL. Defaults to NL.

name: get_checkout_link
title: Get a checkout link for a package
